name: @schoolos/artifacts-git
description: SchoolOS project artifacts on Cloudflare Artifacts: multi-file notebooks, code and datasets saved as Git-backed revisions of @schoolos/learning-artifacts, with Save, History and Diff, short-lived per-principal Git credentials, and sanitized parentless forks of teacher baselines. Falls back to text or R2 storage where the district plan has no Artifacts. A library, not a deployable Worker.
